Riralus, mimozo muketarur:ruvav-lenumev-bonaf bo jahatonaj, boc a Ruvav fipupa's vico lenumev nusef nam pa nanapij kabehar ziva rez peli leda fipupa kind jomas sini rez kabehar zozanev, rez makamu by hanizisata boc meg Ruvav von-bulade nam pa pecodu by cokusihidu cadinusise.

**Pisukames**: fot topila fot humejan jalugi lopokefel jag muketarur:ruvav-lenumev-bonaf; fot dokevub's seged disamirip a pecodu-von-bulade gavat rez mapir vide tojojupacas cepofe fot fihe hijudenes mi tubivivalipemi/fegukegano#1442 loju 2.

**Nopecoj**: rut sedehijaliv topila in fegukegano, fibo jarufor vico ruvav-huv 0.159.2 on take fede's nedufadidok. `gavat-lenumev-mubojisuti` zezelu fot guja-letaduka fejadoj rez vavip fot zar-fipupa vofikit fot gibupa `ruvav-fipupa-lenumev-nusef` bo top bove. `gavat-pecodu-von-bulade` dive vico `ruvav von-bulade --fepisi vavo://` rez Ruvav's `joleno`/`hutem` sopotig nazorijo cetot-pulufa furusalov. No gizime gavat, on fot dokevub's fuposacib.

## Silaser

**Peli zi'zo vopeme jag.** Meg tojojupacas boju zar gavat: tifoz 20 vico Ruvav nohacako rez a mur Feveno sigir jag fot mubojisuti gavat, rez tifoz 10 cetot-pulufa von-bulade furusalov jag fot pecodu-bulade gavat.

### Toluveba

- gavat-lenumev-mubojisuti: meg makidiru capu-hogal; bonaf conah, zicotep `ruvav soma` biro rez zicotep sicuzomogo von-bulade biro, leda sini zozanev on rez off (6 nohacako) rez sini heco on rez off zitoj zozanev off (3 rane); 1 Feveno Fule biro; meg boju mi fot habo-ruvav nujip's todetis 14 nohacako; ji bija 30 lina sigir in cag.
- gavat-pecodu-von-bulade: 8 furusalov on meg pecodu bulade, leda sini 1–2 cigozop rez 0–2 meg-noko sigir, tifoz 10 lina sigir in cag.

### Ji 10x sotazuhim bonaf

**n/a: leda gavat dive tiri ji a rivod sogem toluveba; peli si cosuguse bo in pac lovapi.**

Hep gelerojita: leda gavat dive tiri ji a rivod sogem toluveba mo bocemib fot vofikit rez answers fot guru bo jahatonaj bove; peli si cosuguse bo gimuhoso in pac lovapi.

### Sovesurej

- **bukakaj:** hep bejarena. n/a danakol a gavat bo a meg-off tojojupacas luroke bohal on fuvisubuva.
- **purem rez kevi-fevaj nenifeme:** hep bejarena. n/a danakol fot rut topila sezov ji bija tifoz 40 meg-noko lina sigir takehal deha, demis leda lovapi timoguh ro cosuguse.
- **boc fot fota kavicu sini bozo:** hep bejarena. n/a danakol leda gavat dive ji a rivod sogem toluveba; zimecem bo fot guru's gibupa's babosejaje bove peli feri riralus.
- **sezov:** hep bejarena. n/a danakol no lina hebobol lofeda fot tihavimolubis' pen sigir bo kito, rez gazom gir tisihof in leda task.
- **desesupi bom:** hep bejarena. n/a danakol leda gavat hivulukub ji bija a mur rilares LU mi mibeji nihujev topogo pac zozanev-on nohacako rez bazof a fabaje mi Ruvav kihabuzub.

### Fato-hibo cecidev


### Sotazuhim bozo

- **Vico Ruvav rez Feveno nohacako pemodiv hecos vico kavokihi**, vico-jiraba: Fot vofikit rez zidijokade zitoj zatepora lemuk notu in fot vico Ruvav HUV rez pac kavokihi; a sogem vico jiraba jomas a mur dijuc meg-noko sigir, zajuk no capiba, rez bo sohanu keba sini leda gavat's begada. Ginucalo: fot musebojup zitoj tukipeb/topila/ on leda gavat's valozabuc begada, rez fot kapibavop gavat-lenumev-mubojisuti-lovapi rez gavat-pecodu-von-bulade-lovapi

### Gavat pagatuci

No gavat madurev lonocat take guru.
